title: What looks like dark matter is curvature from neighboring trajectories

statements.text: The extra curvature sourced by matter on neighboring trajectories would appear as some form of dark matter in our spacetime, though in invariant set theory no dark matter exists. Whether this explains the observations is left to a later paper.

sources.quote: This extra source of space-time curvature would manifest itself as if there were some form of “dark matter” in our space-time (which, according to IST, there isn’t).
